issue: चतुर्वतिका दीपक — the book and Drik Panchang print चतुर्वतिका, which is not a word; the sense (a lamp of four wicks, वर्तिका) wants चतुर्वर्तिका, a dropped repha. Aarti Mala has चौमुख दीपक (a four-faced lamp), which supports the sense but not the spelling; no witness prints चतुर्वर्तिका.
तेल चटकि दधि मिश्रित भाषावलि तेरी — भाषावलि ('a string of words, praise'?) and चटकि are unclear; all three witnesses agree (Aarti Mala the same).
our reading: as printed, read: offerings crackled in oil (तेल चटकि) and mixed with curd (दधि मिश्रित), and a string of praises (भाषावलि) to you
alternatives: माषावलि (a row of urad, i.e. vadas fried in oil and soaked in curd, a usual offering to Bhairava), a भ/म misprint; not attested in our witnesses
